wrapper_fixture.construction: Event 0 uses detailed history below. Other 14 events have explicit unavailable sources and unique IDs. Outer wrapper test adapter uses exact existing raw-envelope/hash schema with goal-api-v1 namespace; synthetic IDs/data must never be sent to a service.

cases.name: valid_base
cases.mutation: Use core_event with exact gender/season/source identity.
cases.expected: 15 rows, event0 counts and all four threshold blocks exactly as specified; other events missing.

cases.name: source_unavailable
cases.mutation: Replace home raw reference with explicit unavailable.
cases.expected: home raw_payload_row_count=null; no fake empty history; available away retained; full coverage false.

cases.name: available_empty
cases.mutation: Valid hashed home payload data=[].
cases.expected: home raw_payload_row_count=0 and eligible_prior_count=0; distinct reason from unavailable.

cases.name: nonterminal_rows
cases.mutation: Append NS and LIVE rows to a valid source within limit10.
cases.expected: Raw count increases; terminal/eligible counts and features unchanged; reason counts recorded.

cases.name: capture_equal_asof
cases.mutation: Set fetched_at=as_of with all prior kickoffs earlier.
cases.expected: Accepted time boundary.

cases.name: capture_after_asof
cases.mutation: Set fetched_at=as_of+1 microsecond and re-seal hashes.
cases.expected: SOURCE_REJECTED; chronology violation detected; zero invalid history used.

cases.name: capture_at_cutoff
cases.mutation: Set source/as_of/final capture to exact cutoff, before target kickoff.
cases.expected: Pre-cutoff gate fails; never prospective even with valid hashes.

cases.name: target_or_future_fixture
cases.mutation: Put target fixture ID or history kickoff>=as_of/capture/target into raw source.
cases.expected: Reject source; same/future/target history use remains0.

cases.name: missing_cutoff
cases.mutation: Remove optional plan/cutoff evidence reference.
cases.expected: cutoff_verified=false, diagnostic pre-kickoff counts allowed, prospective eligibility false.

cases.name: asof_after_final
cases.mutation: Set as_of=final_captured_at+1 microsecond.
cases.expected: Explicit ASOF_AFTER_FINAL_INPUT; no chronology repair; no prospective pass.

cases.name: naive_time
cases.mutation: Remove timezone from any provenance timestamp.
cases.expected: Reject ambiguous timestamp before feature computation.

cases.name: wrong_team_or_orientation
cases.mutation: Swap home/away IDs or use unrelated payload teamId / endpoint.
cases.expected: Identity failure; do not fuzzy-match names or swap orientations.

cases.name: gender_collision
cases.mutation: Same display name, different IDs or explicit men/women evidence conflict.
cases.expected: No merge; gender conflict fails strict eligibility.

cases.name: gender_unknown
cases.mutation: Remove gender evidence without inventing a value.
cases.expected: Raw counts preserved; gender=UNKNOWN and strict scoped eligibility=false.

cases.name: season_unknown
cases.mutation: Remove season and keep calendar year in kickoff.
cases.expected: season=UNKNOWN; do not infer season; season-dependent features null.

cases.name: genuine_prior_season
cases.mutation: Add exact same-team older fixture from prior season.
cases.expected: Preserve raw history/cross-season count; never substitute target-season standings.

cases.name: conflicting_same_fixture_season
cases.mutation: Two witnesses of same fixture claim different seasons.
cases.expected: Conflicting identity rejected.

cases.name: duplicate_in_one_response
cases.mutation: Repeat fixture ID inside one raw payload.
cases.expected: Preserve current validator rejection; no inflation or silent dedup.

cases.name: duplicate_cross_side_witness
cases.mutation: Same identical head-to-head fixture appears in home and away responses.
cases.expected: One normalized fixture per event, both witnesses retained, each team's match count counts it once.

cases.name: duplicate_conflict
cases.mutation: Same fixture ID has different teams/scores/kickoff in two witnesses.
cases.expected: Reject conflict; never latest-wins.

cases.name: event_local_sources
cases.mutation: Late event source contains fixture also relevant to earlier event whose source is missing.
cases.expected: Earlier event stays missing; no drawing-wide/global history union.

cases.name: hash_tamper
cases.mutation: Change one raw byte without updating its manifest hash.
cases.expected: Fail before payload parse; no final PASS.

cases.name: resealed_timestamp
cases.mutation: Change valid fetched_at and re-seal every affected hash.
cases.expected: Lineage hash changes even if numeric features stay identical.

cases.name: path_or_output_escape
cases.mutation: Reference unlisted file, parent path, symlink escape or output under production.
cases.expected: Fail closed with no outside writes.

cases.name: target_label_injection
cases.mutation: Add actual_outcome/target_score fields to untrusted final/history metadata.
cases.expected: Explicit predictor allowlist ignores target labels; feature and probability-related decisions unchanged.

cases.name: 4990_rejection_regression
cases.mutation: Replay only synthetic deadline mismatch with original expected disposition.
cases.expected: 15 diagnostic SOURCE_REJECTED rows remain in denominator; no timestamp correction or BK probability calculation.

cases.name: 4991_missing_regression
cases.mutation: All 30 sides explicitly unavailable.
cases.expected: 15 rows; all strict eligibility false across1/3/5/10; null raw counts, no synthetic fixtures.

cases.name: threshold_monotonicity
cases.mutation: Use threshold_boundaries and venue counts independently.
cases.expected: Raw counts independent of t; eligible feature coverage cannot increase with t.

cases.name: order_determinism
cases.mutation: Reverse raw history order or input event traversal in a newly sealed fixture.
cases.expected: Canonical feature output same; source lineage hash may change; output orders0..14.

cases.name: no_effects
cases.mutation: Block DB APIs, sockets, dotenv/environment secret reads, operational imports and all writes except output.
cases.expected: No forbidden operation attempted; both success and rejected mixed-fold paths obey.

cases.name: partial_manifest_failure
cases.mutation: One of six folds has new integrity failure besides known4990 mismatch.
cases.expected: Keep full diagnostic denominator; INCOMPLETE/exit2 and zero DB writes; no silent fold dropping.

cases.name: source_truncation
cases.mutation: Only ten returned matches although observed time span covers less than14days.
cases.expected: Congestion labelled observed_in_capture; calendar-completeness unknown; no fabricated older matches.
